test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 30 Sept 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: In the universal prayer of Jains, Navakara Mantra, what is the literal meaning of ‘Namo Arihantanam' ?

options.text: I bow down to all souls who have escaped all their gati karmas.
I bow down to all preceptors.
I bow to all spiritual masters or divine teachers.
I bow down to all completely liberated souls.

solution:
The correct answer is __**I bow down to all souls who have escaped all their gati karmas.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• “Namo Arihantanam” **is a line from the Navkar Mantra, the most important mantra in Jainism.**
 
• It means **“I bow down to all Arihantas”. **
 
• **Arihantas:**
 
 
• These **are souls who have attained perfect knowledge, vision, bliss, and power.**
 
• They have **conquered their inner enemies, such as anger, pride, deceit, greed, attachment, and abhorrence.** 
 
• **Namo: Means “I bow down to” **
 
 

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__**

 
• Jainism** became prevalent in the 6th century B.C. when Lord Mahavira propagated the religion.**
 
• There** were 24 teachers, referred to as jinas or the Tirthankaras, the last of whom was Lord Mahavira.**
 
• The Vedic religion had turned rigid and orthodox with complicated rituals and the supremacy of Brahmins.
 
• The **Varna system partitioned the people into 4 classes based on their bir**th, where the two upper classes enjoyed various privileges and the lower castes led a miserable life.
 
• The Kshatriyas’ reaction toward the domination of the Brahmins.
 
• The **doctrines of Jainism were taught in the Prakrit language, **making it more understandable to ordinary people than to Sanskrit.
 
• Spread of the new agricultural economy in the north-eastern parts of India due to the use of iron tools.
